correctness.rationale: The Hilbert numerical radius is half the norm of the even–odd off-diagonal Jacobi block. The explicit positive J=BB* has essential upper band edge (a+b)^2, and the increasing scalar boundary Weyl function has precisely one root above it iff kappa>0. At criticality the affine tail recurrence excludes an ell2 eigenstate. Geometric reconstruction proves attainment only above the boundary and gives the exact quadratic onset. The standard-library extracted checker verifies two rational identities and 9 finite-section cases, without being mistaken for an infinite proof.
